summary: Edward Royster, 48, of Denver fell and injured his ankle while hiking in the Pass Creek Lake area, leaving him unable to hike out; rescuers reached him two hours after his ~1 p.m. 911 call and carried him out by litter to the trailhead, then transported him to Heart of the Rockies Medical Center with a compound ankle fracture.
notes: FIBArk weekend incident (article covers the June 14-15, 2014 FIBArk weekend; date pinned to Saturday June 14, 2014, weekday-verified, consistent with the article asset date June 19, 2014). Nine SAR South volunteers + three Chaffee County EMS medics.
